sloka: न पश्यामि भयस्थानम् भयम् चैवोपधारये ।भ्रष्टश्च स्वरयोगो मे चाया चोपहता मम ॥२-६९-२०॥
transliteration: na paśyāmi bhayasthānam bhayam caivopadhāraye ।bhraṣṭaśca svarayogo me cāyā copahatā mama ॥2-69-20॥

translations.english: I do not see any reason for apprehension but I experience only fear. My voice has degenerated. My appearance looks haggard. Without any reason whatsoever I detest myself.
